title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy explicitly set to unsafe-none
description: The response sets Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy to unsafe-none, which is the value that disables the browsing-context separation the header otherwise provides. A document that opens or is opened by a cross-origin window keeps a live opener relationship, enabling window references across origins. The check reports the explicit value; the impact depends on what the page does with opener access.
remediation: Set Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy to same-origin, or same-origin-allow-popups where popups must keep a relationship.
limitation: Observation-level: whether the page relies on cross-origin opener access is a design question the header alone cannot answer.
